name: US Senior Care Facility Finder
tagline: Nursing homes, home health, hospice and senior care facilities by state and city
description: Find nursing homes, home health agencies, hospices, palliative care programs, adult care homes, state veterans homes and community health centers in every US state, with CMS star ratings, staffing, beds, penalties, address and phone from public sources.
item_type: One row per care facility or provider: care type, city, state, address, phone and the values its source publishes (CMS ratings and penalties for nursing homes, services for home health and hospice agencies, licensed beds for adult care homes).

answer.question: Which nursing homes, home health agencies, hospices and other senior care providers are near me, how are they rated, and how do I contact them?

sources.name: CMS Provider Data Catalog: Nursing Home Provider Information and Penalties
sources.note: US federal government data (public domain, 17 U.S.C. 105). Star ratings, staffing, beds, ownership and 3-year penalties joined by CCN from datasets 4pq5-n9py and g6vv-u9sr. Retrieved 2026-09-23; first published on the US Portal Atlas.
